before.label: English
before.title: Time
stanzas: of a question mark you leave me standing—
Whichever way I stretch my hands,
within the vast emptiness before my eyes,
in the eyes of the dove flying away,
among the playfulness of so many words,
my helplessness in not being able
to hear and keep the voice
all beyond the limits of tolerance, is it not?
The tenderness of closing my eyes,
of coating my soul with the sound I hear,
is now beyond tolerance too, is it not!
of the question mark’s coil may open.
O keeper of the final point!
so I may take shelter or
step out and become one with emptiness.

stanzas: गुरुत्व और पृथ्वी के आकर्षण के मध्यबिंदु पर मैं उनकी राह देख रही हूँ
अँधेरे पक्ष के खाँचे में जमा है
अपने पते पर न होने वाले हृदय
क्या इच्छा करना विराम का विधान है!

जानते हो, यह बात भी मान ली गई।
क्या जीवन कुहासे का जंगल है
उठ नहीं पा रहा भ्रम या माया

चौथाई कुहेली और आत्मघाती पीड़ा की
एक पराजित कंकाल है यह पृथ्वी
लाख फूलों के नगर बनाए तो
परार्ध उजाड़ देता है आकस्मिक तूफ़ान

before.label: English
before.title: Mist
stanzas: If you learn, will you tell me?
I wait for them at the midpoint of gravitation and earthly gravity
that they might bring a touch of light
In the recess of the dark fortnight has gathered
that chosen death would be preferable.
Is wishing a decree of respite!
rooted within the circle of their own feet,
in dreams, war and triumphant marches,
to have something accepted as true—
fire may burn in a river,
but a handful of rice cannot boil into food
with only maps within their wombs
saying they will make flowers bloom in a dead universe?
You know, this too was accepted as true.
Is life a forest of mist,
neither illusion nor enchantment can arise?
the desert’s solitude or the scent of dissolution?
Of a quarter-measure of mist and self-destructive pain
This earth is a defeated skeleton
if it builds a hundred thousand cities of flowers,
a sudden storm devastates a parardha of them
by the sky growing emptier and emptier
I wondered, what will happen now
of the sea, the colour blue and me?

before.label: English
before.title: Evening Behag
stanzas: That person was quiet, I too silent
between our two pairs of lips there passed
Touching the circle’s circumference, in the ether
gradually took the shape of a river,
began to dance with the waves
a flock of birds homeward to their nests...
hur-r, hur-r urging of the herd,
I was quiet and that person too silent...
Two pairs of eyes face to face
in the garden of the lowering evening
a girdle of tarata flowers across the sky,
throughout the open land resounding the kendara’s
And between one another still continued
